text: Assumption: Continuous buffer extraction is necessary in the case of a circular buffer — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Continuous buffer extraction is necessary in the case of a circular buffer — is this correct?
norm: continuous buffer extraction is necessary in the case of a circular buffer
assumption: Continuous buffer extraction is necessary in the case of a circular buffer.
rationale: The specification only describes overwriting via wrap-around, from which the operational requirement of prompt reading to avoid data loss is derived.

original.text: Annahme: Notwendigkeit kontinuierlicher Pufferentnahme bei zirkulärem Puffer — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Notwendigkeit kontinuierlicher Pufferentnahme bei zirkulärem Puffer
original.rationale: Die Spezifikation beschreibt lediglich das Überschreiben via Wrap-Around, woraus sich betrieblich das Erfordernis zeitnahen Auslesens zur Vermeidung von Datenverlust ableitet.
